sloka: ततः पुष्करिणीम् वीरौ पंपाम् नाम गमिष्यथः ।अशर्कराम् अविभ्रंशाम् सम तीर्थम् अशैवलाम् ॥३-७३-११॥
transliteration: tataḥ puṣkariṇīm vīrau paṁpām nāma gamiṣyathaḥ ।aśarkarām avibhraṁśām sama tīrtham aśaivalām ॥3-73-11॥

translations.english: The slopes of Pampa are without stones or pebbles, O Rama They are not slippery slopes. They are without moss. The water is neither deep nor shallow. It has smooth beds of sand on the banks and it is full of lotuses and lilies.
translations.hindi: आपके दशन करके सुमे आज तप करने का फल. मिल गया । आज, मेरा तप करना और गुरु की सेवा करना सफल. हुआ
